outcome: The planning lock now guards the harness's own machinery in its own repo: a hand-edit to factory/, constitution/, harness/, .claude/ or .codex/ here needs an approved plan or a bounded quickfix, exactly as a client's product code does — while a client repo's vendored copy of that machinery stays freely writable during planning. Repo kind is a positive .factory/harness-source.json sentinel (never vendored), and a quickfix pins it at start so deleting the marker mid-window can't unlock machinery. A harness-repo quickfix now claims the machinery files it touches against its five-file budget instead of reporting zero.
